desc: Derive the cycle contribution \(1+x_{i-1}-x_i\) and the correct local transition relations for each possible degree.
Precisely characterize collisions between edge orientations and determine how they affect both local degrees and the hub degree.
Characterize, for each local degree word, the full set of attainable spoke counts \(q=d_N\) among cyclic orientation paths.
Build a constant-state \(O(N)\)-time DP that counts distinct complete sequences \((d_0,\ldots,d_N)\), including \(q\).
Validate the corrected algorithm on both samples and edge cases such as all-zero and all-one strings.
